What makes Monaer pads different

As published by Monaer Brake System Malaysia.

  • Nano ceramic pads

    Monaer pads use a nano ceramic friction material, made for quiet stops and clean rims in daily traffic.

  • Built for heat

    Monaer lists heat fade resistance from 600°C, and 800°C on its performance pads, so the bite stays when the brakes get hot.

  • A full kit in every box

    Each pad set comes with brake cleaner spray, gloves and high-temperature anti-noise grease. No extra shopping for the job.

  • Pads, discs and fluid from one brand

    Coated high-carbon discs, DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid, and a pad range made for EVs too.

What you notice on the road

  • Strong, steady bite
  • Quieter braking
  • Less black dust on your rims
  • Holds up when the brakes are hot
  • Longer disc life

These are the points Monaer lists for its nano ceramic pads.

Ceramic or semi-metallic?

Most pads sold in Malaysia are one of these two types. Here is the plain difference.

Nano ceramic (Monaer)Semi-metallic
NoiseQuieterCan squeal more
Wheel dustLight, pale dustMore dark dust
Disc wearGentle on discsWears discs faster
Best forDaily driving, city and highwayHeavy loads, hard use

Questions drivers and workshops ask

Is S & P Precision Parts an authorised Monaer distributor?

Yes. S & P Precision Parts Sdn Bhd in Skudai, Johor is an authorised distributor of Monaer brake parts.

How do I know which Monaer pad fits my car?

WhatsApp us your car make, model, year and engine. We match the Monaer catalogue number to your car's original part number before you buy.

Can I buy direct or do I need a workshop?

Ask us on WhatsApp. We can tell you where to collect and which workshop near you can fit them.
